name: CodeComparison
description: Two code panels, before and after, side by side on wider screens and stacked on phones. Each has a label, line numbers and optional highlighted lines. It does no syntax colouring and has no dependency.

before.description: The code shown in the first panel.

after.description: The code shown in the second panel.

beforeHighlight.description: Line numbers (starting at 1) to mark in the first panel.

afterHighlight.description: Line numbers (starting at 1) to mark in the second panel.

label.description: Accessible name of the whole comparison.

language.description: Language name, shown in the caption and used as a data attribute. No colouring is applied.

keyboard: Tab: moves to each code area, which scrolls with the arrow keys when a line is wide
requirements: The comparison is a group named by label; each panel is a figure with a caption
The code is real text in pre and code, in the server HTML, with no JavaScript needed
Highlighted lines are marked by a bar and a tint, not by colour alone, and the caption lists them in text for screen readers
Line numbers are decoration and are not read or copied
Panels stack on phones and sit side by side from the medium breakpoint, and the page never scrolls sideways
screenReader: Group, then each figure with its caption, the highlighted line numbers, then the code

use_when: Showing a migration or a fix as before and after
Docs that compare two ways to write the same thing
avoid_when: A line-by-line diff of real files (use a diff tool)
